subject.title: chore: sync yuanbao plugin catalog to 2.17.0

question: Should OpenClaw’s trusted official Yuanbao catalog promote the externally published 2.17.0 package after package-level provenance and compatibility review?
rationale: The repository pin causes new or recovering users to install executable external plugin code, while the patch itself only establishes a version and tarball integrity value; maintainers must decide whether that upstream release belongs in the trusted catalog.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Confirm the 2.17.0 release source, manifest/API compatibility, and registry integrity, then merge the refreshed catalog pin.

options.title: Hold the catalog pin
options.body: Keep the existing trusted version until the Yuanbao release receives package-level review or an owner-approved release signal.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the 2.17.0 release source, manifest/API compatibility, and registry integrity, then merge the refreshed catalog pin.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available package publisher signal for the external Yuanbao release whose content the official catalog would select.
